texts.title: Your Suit Is Upheld
texts.body: The praetor has found for the house in the suit you brought, and {defendant.name}'s house has paid what the court set. Nobody made you go to law. The Reach has seen that the choice was sound, and it has seen who was made to pay.

choices.take_what_the_court_gave: Take what the court gave, and say no more.
choices.send_part_of_it_back: Send 300 credits of it back, with a civil letter.
choices.have_the_judgment_read: Have the judgment read where it will be repeated.

texts.title: Your Suit Is Thrown Out
texts.body: The praetor has found against the house in the suit you brought, and the house has paid {defendant.name}'s house what turned on it, besides the fee. A house that is sued and loses is unlucky. A house that sues and loses chose it, and the benches are waiting to see how you take it.

choices.go_and_say_it_is_ended: Call on {defendant.him}, and say it is ended.
choices.say_it_will_be_brought_again: Say there will be other years, and other benches.

texts.title: A Charge Admitted
texts.body: The charge against {admitted.name} will not be heard. You admitted it for the house and paid the fine, and the accuser has nothing left to bring. {admitted.first} was not asked whether {admitted.he} would rather have stood in court and answered it, and has not said.

choices.let_them_carry_it: The house has paid. The rest is {admitted.hers} to carry.
choices.tell_them_what_it_cost: Tell {admitted.him}, in private, what it cost.
